code_blocks.content:
Article Angle Brief Board

Compare article angles, shape title/meta/outline cards, then copy a compact brief.

Setup Angles Brief

1. Topic and audience

Keep this rough. The brief gets cleaner as the cards improve.

Local only No APIs Phone friendly

2. Compare 3 to 5 angles

Score each angle from 1 to 5. Tap “rank” when you want the strongest ideas on top.

3. Edit brief cards

Use these as the final article planning blocks.

4. Copy article brief

Builds a concise handoff brief from your current board.

Everything runs in this file. Autosaves in this browser with localStorage.
